segments.name: vertically integrated solar power products manufacturing business
segments.description: Manufactures and sells solar power products, silicon ingots, wafers, cells and solar modules, plus energy storage products, to customers worldwide as one integrated business.
segments.evidence: Hence, we have only one operating segment which is vertically integrated solar power products manufacturing business from silicon ingots, wafers, cells to solar modules.

revenueModel.text: Customers worldwide buy photovoltaic products, mainly solar modules, and ESS products from the group, which pays for manufacturing and shipping them.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue from sales of photovoltaic products decreased by 30.5% from RMB89.99 billion in 2024 to RMB62.53 billion (US$8.94 billion) in 2025, primarily due to a decrease in average selling price of solar modules compared to 2024.
